content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Lake Charles

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for professionals new to project management in Lake Charles's petrochemical, energy, and industrial sectors. Verify your educational background meets PMI requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses core project management knowledge into a focused schedule, allowing you to balance certification training with your current job responsibilities while preparing for the CAPM exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, create your PMI account and submit your official CAPM application. Provide proof of your secondary degree and training completion. Pay the associated exam fee to activate your eligibility to sit for the certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review key concepts and practice questions. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify content and reinforce your readiness before exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, maintain your credential by earning professional development units over a three-year renewal cycle. Participate in PMI-approved training, conferences, or volunteer activities. Plan your PDU strategy early to ensure seamless renewal and continued recognition in your profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
